mcp.connect: Create a dedicated API key with mcp:connect and the scopes for the tools you want to use. Start with links:read for read-only link access. Revoke the key from the API keys page when you no longer need it.
mcp.client: Linkrovia connects to AI tools over Streamable HTTP using a scoped API key.
mcp.environment: Set LINKROVIA_MCP_TOKEN in the environment where this client runs, then restart the client.
mcp.merge: Merge the example into your existing settings if the file already exists.
mcp.approveClaudeCode: Open the project in Claude Code, trust the project and approve the Linkrovia server when prompted.
mcp.vsCode: VS Code prompts for the key when it connects.
mcp.claudeConnector: In Claude, add a custom web connector under Customize → Connectors. Enter the endpoint above, choose No sign-in and add the header under Request headers. Replace YOUR_LINKROVIA_API_KEY with your key.
mcp.claudeNetwork: The request header feature is in limited beta. Claude connects from its cloud and requires a publicly reachable HTTPS endpoint on port 443.
mcp.claudeDesktop: Install Node.js and mcp-remote 0.16.6. In Claude Desktop, open Settings → Developer → Edit Config. Set LINKROVIA_MCP_AUTHORIZATION in the environment inherited by Claude Desktop to Bearer followed by a space and your key. Fully restart Claude Desktop.
mcp.chatgpt: ChatGPT custom apps use OAuth to connect to authenticated servers. This endpoint uses an API key.
mcp.secret: Some clients store keys in plain text. Use your client’s secret storage or an environment variable when available.
